concerns.text: FR-008 requires a deterministic, verifiable vocabulary mapping layer. Task T044 only states implementation of a mapping but provides no concrete algorithm, output format, or verification step, and the subsequent fallback (T044‑Fallback) is conditional on a status that is never produced because the mapping itself is undefined.

Constitution Principle VI (Cross‑Lingual Subspace Isolation) mandates an explicit intersection‑size check and a warning file. Task T065 claims to implement this check but does not specify logging of the intersection size, nor does it produce the required `data/processed/vocab_alignment_warning.json` output, violating FR-008 and the constitution.

The feasibility gate (T060) is incomplete: it never logs a detailed warning, never marks T012b as SKIPPED, and does not generate the mandated `data/processed/feasibility_report.json`. This breaches FR-005/SC-005 and Constitution Principle I (Reproducibility).

FR-006 specifies a minimum of 1,000,000 tokens for frequency distributions. Task T041 adds a validation step but the earlier frequency‑distribution tasks (T019a/b) do not enforce this threshold, so the acceptance criterion can be bypassed, weakening FR-006.

SC-004 requires dimensionality reduction (e.g., PCA) before correlating the shift vector with WALS features. Task T042 performs correlation directly on the full shift vector, violating the specification.

SC-001 demands a confidence interval for anisotropy deviation. Task T015 computes a bootstrap percentile interval, but the spec does not prescribe this method; the lack of an explicit, spec‑compliant CI calculation makes the success criterion under‑specified and effectively weakens SC-001.

Spec SC-005 assumes a GitHub Actions runner with 4 vCPU and 16 GB RAM, yet the plan (and consequently the tasks) state the target platform has only 2 vCPU and 7 GB RAM, creating a contradictory resource assumption that can render the pipeline infeasible.

FR-001 requires SVD on the *full* projected matrix. Task T012 explicitly forbids using a subset of rows/columns, but the preceding feasibility pre‑check (T012b‑PRECHECK) may cause the model to be marked ‘SKIPPED’ and then processed by the randomized fallback (T012c). This conditional substitution weakens the guarantee of a full‑matrix SVD for all models.

The randomized SVD fallback (T012c) is allowed only when memory exceeds 6 GB, but the spec does not permit a fallback that changes the mathematical definition of the edge spectrum; this constitutes a silent weakening of FR-001.
